title: VQA-EKF: quality-adaptive vision noise for marker-based landing in ArduPilot EKF3 — code, parameters and flight data
description: Flight software, analysis software, flight-controller parameters, campaign workbooks, companion-computer logs and frozen analysis outputs for a randomised 90-sortie flight study of quality-adaptive vision measurement noise in the unmodified ArduPilot EKF3 (E1: optical flow fused; E3: vision only). Supports the article 'VQA-EKF: quality-adaptive vision measurement noise for GNSS-denied UAV precision landing in a production autopilot'.
notes: Funded by REVA University seed funding, Ref. REVA/IRoC-U/2026/DAC-001.
